jobs.title: Principal AI Architect Tel Aviv
jobs.description: Location Tel Aviv Experience Level Senior Department R&D Apply for this position In this role, you’ll define the company’s architectural vision, establish engineering standards, and drive technical decisions across multiple R&D teams. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, AI, Security, and Data teams to build scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions while evaluating and adopting cutting-edge AI technologies. This is a highly strategic and hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineering teams, and shaping the future of modern AI products. Responsibilities Define and lead the architectural vision across the organization. Design scalable, secure, and high-performance distributed systems. Establish architecture standards, best practices, and technical guidelines across multiple engineering teams. Design and lead enterprise authentication, authorization, SSO, Groups, Policies, and identity management solutions. Architect advanced GenAI solutions, including RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, LLM integrations, AI Agents, Guardrails, and large-scale inference workloads. Define reference architectures and engineering standards for deployment, monitoring, observability, reliability, and security. Drive architectural decisions around scalability, performance, availability, security, and operational efficiency. Own the architectural roadmap while balancing business value, operational costs (COGS), scalability, and long-term maintainability. Lead Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and developer productivity tools. Promote engineering excellence through CI/CD best practices, observability, monitoring, security, and compliance. Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, AI, DevOps, Security, Data teams, customers, and strategic partners. Requirements 10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years in architecture or technical leadership roles. Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems running on Kubernetes. Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience designing cloud-native architectures, microservices, serverless applications, and data pipelines. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience designing and deploying On-Premise / Air-Gapped environments. Practical experience working with Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, AI Agents, MCP, or similar AI frameworks. Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance optimization. Experience implementing security and compliance best practices, including IAM, Secrets Management, and infrastructure hardening. Excellent architectural thinking, problem-solving, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on software development experience with Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or similar languages. Experience deploying SaaS and On-Premise enterprise products. Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar observability platforms. Experience with GPU optimization, AI inference infrastructure, or large-scale AI workloads. Experience working in fast-growing AI startups or enterprise software companies. Ready to scale AI with control? jobs.title: Accessibility Statement
jobs.description: Accessibility Statement Jeen AI, operating and managing the https://jeen.ai, is committed to ensuring the accessibility of its digital services to all citizens, with a special emphasis on improving access for individuals with disabilities. Significant resources have been allocated to guarantee the accessibility of our website, aiming to enhance the experience for individuals with diverse needs, including but not limited to motor disabilities, cognitive impairments, myopia, blindness or color blindness, hearing impairments, and the elderly population. The implementation of website accessibility has been carried out by “VEE – Website Accessibility.” Our website has been optimized for accessibility at level AA, adhering to the guidelines established by the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations WCAG2.2. Vee Company, the provider of website accessibility solutions, has ensured compatibility with popular web browsers and mobile devices. Extensive testing has been conducted using Jaws and NVDA screen readers. Additionally, we have implemented WCAG2.2 recommendations by the W3C organization to further enhance accessibility standards. Our website facilitates a straightforward process to switch to accessible mode. An accessibility icon is prominently placed on each webpage. Clicking on the icon opens the accessibility menu, allowing users to select desired accessibility functions. Please allow the page to load after making your selection to ensure the appropriate changes are applied. To revert the changes, simply click on the corresponding function in the menu again. Resetting the accessibility settings is also an option. The accessibility software is compatible with popular web browsers, such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Opera. For an optimal experience with screen reader software, we recommend using the latest version of NVDA. The website’s design includes a semantic structure supporting assistive technologies and adheres to accepted usage patterns for keyboard navigation. Several improvements have been made to enhance accessibility on the site, including adaptation for screen readers, clear and intuitive navigation, organized content presentation, optimization for modern web browsers, compatibility with various screen sizes, and consistent structure across all pages. Alt text has been included for all images. The accessibility software provides essential functionalities, including adaptation for screen readers, flickering prevention, direct content access, keyboard navigation adjustment, text size adjustment, enhanced spacing, contrast and color options, legible font selection, highlighting links, reading guide, customizable mouse cursor, and image descriptions. Exclusions: While diligent efforts have been made to ensure the accessibility of all pages and elements, it is acknowledged that there may still be instances where certain parts or functionalities are not fully accessible. Continuous efforts are underway to enhance accessibility and ensure inclusivity for all individuals, including those with disabilities. If you encounter accessibility issues on the website, please contact us with complete details, including a problem description, the action you attempted, the link to the page you browsed, browser type and version, operating system, and the type of assistive technology used. Jeen AI is committed to addressing accessibility concerns promptly and professionally.
